standard_prerequisites.name: The equivalence between Jacobsonness and a condition on locally closed subsets through closed points
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source line 3733)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the assertion to a retrocompactness comparison.

standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that the closed points are inherited by open subsets
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 3737-3738)
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows replacing the space by a given open subset.

core_obligations: Reduce by the earlier equivalence: it remains to see that for an open subset the trace of the closed points is retrocompact there exactly when the subset is retrocompact in the space (proof lines 3733-3736)
Localize: that in turn is equivalent to the corresponding statement about quasi-compactness of open subsets, and one may replace the space by the open subset (proof lines 3737-3739)

Conclude by the Jacobson property: a family of opens covers the space exactly when it covers the set of closed points, because a nonempty complement would contain a closed point by Jacobsonness (proof lines 3740-3744)
proof_roadmap: 由前面「Jacobson ⟺ 某局部闭条件」的等价，只需比较：U 开时 U ∩ X_0 在 X_0 中 retrocompact ⟺ U 在 X 中 retrocompact。
这又化为「U ∩ X_0 准紧 ⟺ U 准紧」，并可由「闭点被开子集继承」把 X 换成 U。
最后：一族开集覆盖 X ⟺ 覆盖 X_0——若不然，补集非空闭，由 Jacobson 性含闭点，矛盾。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives a characterization of Jacobsonness of a Kolmogorov space through the behaviour of the closed points (author lemma at source lines 3718-3731, label lemma-jacobson-equivalent-constructible). The proof (source lines 3733-3745) reduces by the earlier equivalence to a retrocompactness comparison, localizes it to quasi-compactness of opens, and concludes with the covering criterion provided by the Jacobson property on the complement (proof lines 3733-3744). The reduction and the covering criterion are the substance. H3.
